key_insight: MCGPO improves LLM agent training by turning already-collected sibling rollouts into context-matched action preferences with rubric-aware evidence.
engineering_relevance: It offers a critic-free, data-efficient way to assign intermediate credit in long-horizon agents while reusing rollout history and terminal feedback.
method: Build comparison contexts from pre-action state summaries plus observed rubric progress.
Use two-action support with ordered exact/coarse matching to select valid action pairs.
Apply fixed folds and support-dependent weights to orient preferences and train alongside GraphGPO.
evidence_signal: Across six environment-backbone settings and three seeds each, MCGPO improves mean success over matched GraphGPO on ALFWorld and WebShop, with the largest gains on WebShop using Qwen3-4B and 8B.
watch_item: The gains on ALFWorld are modest because baseline success is already above 92%, so remaining improvement headroom is limited.
paper_title: Matched-Context Group Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training
